newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA BRAIN DRAIN CONTINUES APACE IN AUGUST - CSS.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA BRAIN DRAIN CONTINUES APACE IN AUGUST - CSS.

text.p: The South African brain drain continued apace in August after a total of 778 people emigrated, 6.1 percent more than in the same month last year, latest Central Statistical Service (CSS) data shows.
At the same time the number of immigrants to the country rose 70 percent from the same time a year ago.

The CSS said of the 778 people who emigrated, 410 of them were economically active. This brought the number of economically active people who have emigrated between January and August to 3,826. Total emeigrant numbers reached 7,237.
The bulk of those who left the country worked either in professional, semi-professional or technical fields.

The number of people who immigrated to South Africa was up 70 percent at 425 people. Of those who immigrated, 142 were economically active, bringing the total number of economically active immigrants to 1,224 so far this year out of a total number of 3,307.
Of the total number of emigrants, 296 were destined for countries in Europe -- mostly the U.K. -- while 180 left for North America and 157 headed for Australia and New Zealand.
